affordance_in_statement: A certificate consists of exactly three distinct materials with the following property: if we restrict our attention only to these three materials, the maximum number of materials you can select from this trio to form a safe set is exactly one.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving edit that removes this shortcut: the stated certificate condition is intrinsically equivalent to requiring all three pairwise volatility edges.
